نتشاطر (form VI)
# نَتَشَاطَرُ (natašāṭaru) /na.ta.ʃaː.tˤa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَشَاطَرَ (tašāṭara)
# نَتَشَاطَرَ (natašāṭara) /na.ta.ʃaː.tˤa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَاطَرَ (tašāṭara)
# نَتَشَاطَرْ (natašāṭar) /na.ta.ʃaː.tˤar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَاطَرَ (tašāṭara)
